info.title: OpenBoxes API
info.description: The OpenBoxes REST API. OpenBoxes is an open-source inventory and supply-chain management system for health commodities, built on Grails; every endpoint lives under the application context path, normally `/openboxes`, at `/api`. The OpenFn openboxes adaptor reaches it with generic `get(path)` / `post(path, data)` / `request(method, path, data)` helpers, so any endpoint here is reachable from a job. Responses are normally wrapped in a `data` envelope (list endpoints add `totalCount`); a few endpoints are exceptions and are described individually. Authentication is a `JSESSIONID` cookie obtained from `POST /api/login`.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a `JSESSIONID` session cookie in `Set-Cookie`. The body is plain text (`Authentication was successful`), not JSON. Every later request replays the cookie. The openfn openboxes adaptor reaches this as `<baseUrl>/login`, where `baseUrl` normally ends in `/openboxes/api`.

location.description: Optional id of the location to log in to.

200.description: Authentication was successful. A JSESSIONID cookie is set.

post.summary: Update a stock movement or its line items
post.description: Also used to add, revise, substitute, cancel, revert and remove line items by posting a `lineItems` array with the relevant per-item attributes.

post.summary: Transition a stock movement to another status
post.description: Statuses run CREATED, PENDING, REQUESTED, VALIDATED, CHECKING, PICKING, PICKED, ISSUED and CANCELED. `statusOnly` skips the transition's business logic; `rollback` reverts the current status; `clearPicklist`/`createPicklist` apply when entering PICKING.

parameters.name: stepNumber
parameters.description: Shape the response for a particular workflow step (only 4 differs today).

get.summary: List putaway candidates for a facility

post.summary: Create, update, split or complete a putaway
post.description: The same endpoint creates a draft putaway, updates it, splits items (via `splitItems`) and completes it (set the root `putawayStatus` to `COMPLETE`). Posting a completed putaway twice creates duplicates.

get.summary: Get the partial-receipt candidates for a shipment

200.description: The receipt and its outstanding items.

post.summary: Save, complete or roll back a partial receipt
post.description: Nothing is written until `receiptStatus` is `COMPLETE`, which also creates the inbound transaction; `ROLLBACK` reverses previously received quantities.

get.summary: List instances of a domain resource
get.description: The Generic API exposes every OpenBoxes domain class as a REST resource. `resource` is the lower-camel-case domain class name, e.g. `product`, `category`, `shipment`, `shipmentItem`, `requisition`, `requisitionItem`, `inventoryItem`, `transaction`, `transactionEntry`. Not every domain binds cleanly, so some resources reject writes.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Index of the first record to return.

post.summary: Create one or many instances of a domain resource
post.description: Posting an object creates one instance; posting an array creates several in a single all-or-nothing transaction. Posting objects that carry an `id` updates them instead.

get.summary: Search instances of a domain resource
get.description: Criteria are `searchAttributes`: a property, an operator (`eq`, `like`, `ilike`) and a value. Only string properties are supported today.

LocationType.description: A location's type, e.g. Depot, Ward, Bin Location or Supplier.

name.description: Localisable name; may carry `|fr:` style translations.

Location.description: A facility, ward or bin location. Internal locations (bins, receiving areas) are Locations whose parentLocation is a depot. Responses always carry `id` and `name`; request bodies and embedded references carry a subset.

id.description: 32-character hex identifier (or a short numeric id for seed data).

locationGroup.description: Location group, when the location belongs to one. Shape not documented.

CategoryRef.description: Compact reference to a product category as embedded in other resources.

Category.description: A product category. Categories form a tree via parentCategory. Responses always carry `id`; request bodies and embedded references carry a subset.

Product.description: A product (item) in the catalogue. Responses always carry `id`; request bodies and embedded product references carry a subset (often just name and productCode).

productCode.description: Auto-generated when not supplied on create.

category.description: Category reference; some endpoints render it as the category name only.

UserRef.description: Compact reference to a user (requester, assignee, recipient).

LocationRef.description: Compact reference to a location as embedded in other resources.

ReasonCode.description: A translated reason code for an activity (substitution, modification, picklist change).

InventoryItem.description: A lot (batch) of a product, identified by lot number and expiration date.

expirationDate.description: MM/DD/YYYY or ISO 8601 depending on the endpoint.

AvailableItem.description: Availability of one lot of a product in one bin location. Keys are flattened dotted paths.

StockMovementItem.description: A line item of a stock movement (a requisition item plus its picklist/substitution state).

StockMovement.description: A stock movement: an outbound (or inbound) transfer of stock between two locations. Responses always carry `id`; request bodies carry a subset.

Stocklist.description: A requisition template (stock list) of products and quantities for a location.

RequisitionItem.description: A product line on a requisition or stock list.

PutawayItem.description: A candidate or planned putaway line. Keys are flattened dotted paths.

Putaway.description: A putaway: moving received stock from a receiving bin into storage bins.

PartialReceiptItem.description: A shipment item being received, with shipped/received/remaining quantities.

PartialReceiptContainer.description: A shipment container (box, pallet) grouping items on a partial receipt.

PartialReceipt.description: A (possibly draft) receipt against an inbound shipment. Saved only when receiptStatus is COMPLETE.

Localization.description: A single localized message resolved for a locale.

LocalizationBundle.description: All localized messages for a locale, plus the supported locale list.

GenericRecord.description: Any OpenBoxes domain object served through the Generic API. Fields depend on the domain class.

ServerStatus.description: Application and database health, from GET /api/status.

data.description: Validation errors, when the failure is a binding/validation failure.
